Slightly distant oblique view, medium-wide framing, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Main subject: a young adult with a medium build wearing a light work shirt and dark cargo trousers with muted orange workwear accents, lying fully horizontal face-down on the floor, with chest, abdomen, pelvis, and legs supported by the ground.
